title: rustscenic: a Rust and Python implementation of SCENIC-style regulatory-network analysis
description:
RustScenic is a Rust and PyO3 implementation of SCENIC-style gene regulatory network analysis, including GRN inference, AUCell scoring, topic modelling, cisTarget enrichment, enhancer linking, eRegulon assembly and an end-to-end Python pipeline API.

Created and led by Ekin Kahraman, with Longtao Huangfu, Mohamed El Moussaoui, Fuaad Siyaad and Kuan-Lin Huang, in collaboration with the Huang Lab at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai.

Ekin Kahraman: software creation, architecture, Rust and Python implementation, benchmarks, releases and maintenance. Longtao Huangfu: real-data execution, scaling and dataset production. Mohamed El Moussaoui: HPC resources and analysis support. Fuaad Siyaad: ATAC preprocessing tests and validation feedback. Kuan-Lin Huang: scientific supervision, resource concept and collaboration direction.
